build_H2HEvaler: build a python module to create an H2HEvaler that spawns rollout and aggregate worker processes for head-to-head evaluation
run_eval_worker: run the H2HEvaler eval_worker class method to play games between agent one and agent six and push results to a queue
run_aggregate_worker: run the H2HEvaler aggregate_worker class method to collect game results from a queue and log metrics per epoch
call_H2HEvaler_terminate: call the H2HEvaler terminate method to kill all spawned rollout and aggregate worker processes
call_set_all_logger_handlers_to_level: call _set_all_logger_handlers_to_level to set the log level on all handlers attached to a logger instance
